# GitHub Workflow

This directory contains repository workflow templates.

- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`: checklist for source changes before review.
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md`: bug report template for firmware, tooling, or replay issues.
- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/task.md`: general engineering task template.

Use issues for work that changes estimator, predictor, actuation, logging, replay, or calibration behavior. Pull requests should call out flight-safety impact, replay coverage, and bench validation status when relevant.
